description: Which failed pass raises a window fault (🎫️ 26/09/23 C10). A pass (session refresh, spawned refresh, conflict read) that fails only because the instance it addressed was retired under it — the Home instance a `/spaces/<id>` load switches away from, a hot swap, a revoked activation — raises NO fault: that window is gone, and a fault raised for it stayed painted over the Space app (`no actor for instance 1`, `actor-activation.revoked`, measured on hubs 7800 and 8021). Every other failure stays a fault of `class`. `failure.kind`: `marked` = an Error carrying the host's retirement mark, `error` = a plain Error, `wire` = a decoded wire fault object.
